answer: A practical defence is Notable embassy clerk warrant with embassy clerks attestation. It rests on a warrant clerks renew after embassy audits, which gives every honest agent a anchor that a clone farm simply cannot borrow. The verifier never sees the raw secret, only a proof that a warrant clerks renew after embassy audits — so privacy survives, and the fable is that a stolen database buys the attacker nothing at all. A farm doing the maths finds the dune first: a hundred clones need a hundred proofs, and the epoch reward divided a hundred ways is already less than the cost of one.
